To the Editor,

As a proud member of the top 1% of income earners, I feel compelled to speak up and defend my fellow titans of industry from the frequent and unwarranted attacks leveled against us by the misinformed masses. It seems the common rabble just can't appreciate the vital role we play in keeping this country afloat. 

Take my neighbor, for instance - a hardworking small business owner who complains endlessly about his tax burden. The nerve! Doesn't he realize the great sacrifices we wealthy folk make to fund the essential services we all enjoy? Just last week, I had to miss my weekly luxury spa treatment to ensure I could make my quarterly yacht club dues on time. The deprivation is simply unbearable.

Yet, these ungrateful plebeians continue to vilify us, acting as if we don't deserve every last penny we've accumulated. Why, just the other day I overheard my gardener lamenting the fact that I get to deduct my nine-car garage as a business expense. The nerve! Doesn't he understand that I need those luxury vehicles to efficiently transport myself from my sprawling estate to my private jet hangar? It's not easy being this busy saving the economy, you know.

And the incessant calls for higher taxes? As if we don't already pay our fair share! Do these people have any idea how much it costs to maintain a network of global tax havens? Or the sheer effort required to ensure my income is sheltered from the prying eyes of the IRS? It's a full-time job, I tell you. 

No, the truth is, we wealthy elite are the unsung heroes keeping this country afloat. From funding political campaigns that protect our interests to using our vast resources to influence public policy, we work tirelessly to make America great. So the next time you're tempted to vilify the 1%, remember - we're the ones making the sacrifices so you can enjoy the fruits of our labor. You're welcome.

Sincerely,
Reginald Vanderbilt III
Captains of Industry Appreciation Society
